# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

He has a mustache that he frequently curls.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Mr. Phillips is a sarcastic, angry, and vindictive teacher who carries out his discipline with a high hand. He is negligent toward his younger students while devoting his time to the older scholars he prepares for entrance examinations. He lacks imagination and shows favoritism toward certain pupils.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P33](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0033), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Traits

- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Vindictive  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- Neglegent  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Lacks imagination  <sub>[v1 c11 P33](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0033)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster for the Avonlea school. During his tenure, he spent much of his time at the back of the classroom explaining lessons to Prissy Andrews, with whom he was courting, while neglecting his younger pupils and allowing the rest of the school to do as they pleased. He was known for his sarcastic punishments, such as forcing Anne Shirley to stand in front of the blackboard with a humiliating inscription after she broke her slate over Gilbert Blythe's head, or making her sit with Gilbert for being late. He also whipped Sam Boulter for talking back in class. After completing his term, he delivered a tearful farewell speech to his students upon his departure from the school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Boarded at Eben Wright's house while teaching in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- Had an uncle who served as a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Quotes

> Anne Shirley, what does this mean?  <sub>[v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041)</sub>

> I am sorry to see a pupil of mine displaying such a temper and such a vindictive spirit. Anne, go and stand on the platform in front of the blackboard for the rest of the afternoon.  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>

> Anne Shirley, since you seem to be so fond of the boys’ company we shall indulge your taste for it this afternoon. Take those flowers out of your hair and sit with Gilbert Blythe.  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061)</sub>

> The time has come for us to part.  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
